acceptance: Grant and revoke gate observation per (scheme, host, port), confirmed by browser-side execution contexts; page scripts, content-script contexts and foreign callers cannot issue commands; malformed grants are rejected.

positive.fixture: grant A, capture A, revoke A, grant B

negative.fixture: hostile page, compromised content-script sender, 11 malformed commands, wildcard host

security_and_source_permissions: Only user-authorized origins are observed; form values and secret-shaped text never leave the page; no source application server is contacted; bridge and extension commands are origin- and sender-checked.
known_limitations: Finding: browser host permissions ignore the port, so VSF's own grant list is the per-origin boundary (documented in mv3-design-review.md)
